sentences.text: No; under the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises with sanctioned amount up to ₹50 lakh, and this case falls within that rule.
This loan is a floating-rate business loan to an MSE, sanctioned on 15 March 2026, for ₹40 lakh, so the pre-payment charge is not permitted.
